Looking at this program, I need to translate:
- `ingest` entry: simple return-only kernel
- `search` entry: complex kernel with workgroup arrays, two-phase reduction (per-thread top-64, then cross-thread merge)

Key structures to handle:
- Two workgroup arrays (wg_a f32, wg_ua u32), each 1024 elements
- 6 top-level statements in search body (init loop, search if, wg-write loop, barrier) + 6-statement merge epilogue
- Repeated 0xFFFFFFFF sentinel (computed via `convert.bits_to_index` from bit ops)
- All `pa[k]`/`pua[k]` array indices use `safe.pidx64` for the 64-element masking

